title: Plein Air Magazine's July issue
content: The July issue of Plein Air magazine always saves its last page for a special item called "Painters Painted." For the June-July issue they chose to feature the sketches Jeanette and I did of our fellow artists.You can see my sketch being made at the video "Plein Air Monterey" on YouTube.The new issue of Plein Air has feature articles on Marc Hanson, Michele Byrne, Billy Solitario, Kim Casebeer, Susan Lynn, Ed Terpening, Carol Strock-Wasson, and Sargent's Watercolors.Plein Air magazine's website
